i'm having a problem understanding how to write my plots in english. 
i am aware that i need to use \usepackage{graphicx}\usepackage{framed}
what i don't understand is how to do this without using words. i am aware that i can use plot command to create a graph. i just don't know how to use this in english and add colours where i need it. any help would be appreciated.

a:

if you want an english version of the package, i would suggest to add the text commands via
\usepackage[texttoc, 
         style=authoryear,
          % text toc
          right=0.5in, 
          % text style
          back color=blue!20, 
          % show page number in title
          citecolor=red!50, 
          % show authors
